articles.title: Lib Dem MP quits frontbench job over Ed Davey's leadership
articles.summary: Deputy party leader Daisy Cooper says "the vast majority of our MPs support Ed... and are furious at this distraction."

articles.title: Hurricane Isaias disrupts U.S. oil production in Gulf of Mexico, threatens refineries
articles.summary: The hurricane could tighten a fuel market that is already facing big disruptions from the wars in Eastern Europe and the Middle East.

articles.title: China, EU reach deal to 'moderate' China's car exports to EU
articles.summary: An agreement between the EU and China would reduce exports of Chinese electric and plug-in hybrid cars to the 27-member European bloc by up to 50%, according to the EU trade envoy.

articles.title: Ledger investigates fund losses linked to Southeast Asian reseller, warns users
articles.summary: Hardware wallet maker Ledger probes losses tied to reseller CryptoBilis, as researchers separately estimate more than $72 million to $86 million in suspected crypto thefts.

articles.title: LumenUs helps automate tedious paperwork in times of grief
articles.summary: "The day your loved one passes away, you also get this honorary badge of a project manager for a project you had no idea about," said founder Sara Tashakorinia.

articles.title: Danu Robotics’ fight to build a better recycling robot
articles.summary: For six years, Danu founder Amy Ma has been working on a better way to sort recyclable waste.
